brief.prompt: A classical white marble bust of a woman displayed on a stone pedestal in a quiet museum gallery, lit by soft side light from a tall window. The background is a plain warm-grey wall, with the bust centered and filling most of the frame.
brief.alt: Classical marble bust representing historical golden ratio face ideals
brief.purpose: Introduces the historical idea that beauty follows fixed mathematical proportions, the starting point of the golden ratio face concept.

review.alt: Classical white marble bust of a woman with an elaborately braided and pinned-up hairstyle and draped, pinned garment, gazing slightly to the side, displayed on a round plinth atop a grey stone pedestal beside a tall window with soft side light against a plain warm-grey wall.
